name: Sprasa Travel
tagline: An online travel agency platform: search flights, confirm the fare with the airline, pay online and receive a real PNR and e-ticket.
highlights: Flight search, filters and live fare re-check
Pay by eSewa, Khalti, QR or bank transfer
Real airline PNR and PDF e-ticket by email and SMS
Admin: bookings, payment checks, markups, profit reports
Ready for Travelport, Sabre, Amadeus and local suppliers
